summary: Frontend E2E for Phase 2 Intake Agent on Sami Rahman's enc_fc5e6d2f320f — all 10 review scenarios pass end-to-end. Verified: doctor login → Intake section badge 'Not generated' + Generate Intake button → clicking it fires the LLM (~36s), badge flips to 'Sent to patient' and exactly 8 tailored questions render each initially 'Not answered yet'; patient login shows intake-prompt-card with doctor name / visit date and 'Complete pre-visit questions' button linking to /intake/{enc}; wizard shows one question per screen with progress label 'Question X of 8', supports single_choice, multi_choice, scale (0-10) and free-text controls with proper data-testids; Next/Back navigation works and Back preserves previously chosen answers (verified bg-forest class stays applied on the earlier option); navigating away to /dashboard mid-wizard and returning correctly RESUMES at the first UNANSWERED question (Q4 of 8, not Q1); completion path shows intake-complete screen with intake-back-to-dashboard-btn, and after completion the dashboard no longer renders the intake-prompt-card for that encounter; the doctor's notification bell surfaces 'Sami Rahman completed pre-visit intake' tagged 'INTAKE · INFO', styled with border-sage/50 bg-sage/10 (sage/green) — distinct from the critical alerts which use border-terracotta/40 bg-terracotta/5; the doctor's Intake section badge now reads 'COMPLETE' with all 8 Q/A rows showing the patient's answer + check icon; clicking Regenerate Briefing (v2 prompt) produced a briefing that clearly cites the intake — evidence contains 'Intake conflicts: patient answered "Never"…' and 'Pre-visit intake: patient wrote "I have been feeling okay…"', and Discussion Points references 'intake sleep rating 5/10' and the '"I forgot" barrier'; cross-patient access blocked — sami@… visiting /intake/enc_8eb16f42b750 renders data-testid=intake-error with copy 'This intake form belongs to another patient' and no questions; regression — /doctor still lists 11 patients, /doctor/schedule lists 21 encounters, Omar's enc_1a4e941c523b still renders as a read-only signed briefing (no regenerate button, 'signed' indicator present).

integration_issues.issue: When a briefing already exists BEFORE the patient completes intake, it does NOT auto-refresh or surface a hint that intake answers are now available; the doctor must manually click Regenerate Briefing for the v2 prompt to incorporate intake evidence. Regenerate produces the correct intake-cited briefing (~30s), so functionally fine but a UX gap.

action_items: Optional UX: on the encounter page, when intake status transitions to complete AND an existing briefing pre-dates that timestamp, show a 'Regenerate to include intake' hint next to regenerate-briefing-btn.

Testability: /auth page inputs do not expose data-testid=auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-btn (only input[type=email]/[type=password] and button[type=submit]). Adding testids would harden future tests.

Consider adding data-testid on the 'INTAKE · INFO' badge span and on the alert row itself (data-testid=alert-row-{id}) so info-vs-critical severity can be asserted without relying on className substrings.
critical_code_review_comments: Intake.jsx `isYesNo` treats any 2-option single_choice with 'Yes'/'No' options (case-insensitive, trimmed) as a boolean YesNo — fine, but the persisted answer becomes the literal string 'Yes' or 'No'. Backend/agent must match on that exact casing when reasoning; a lower-case option would silently render as YesNo but persist 'Yes'/'No' (mismatch). Worth verifying agents/prompts/previsit_v2.md and get_intake_responses() handle both. Not observed to fail in this run.
Intake.jsx `next()` blocks completion when required questions are missing but jumps back silently via setStep; a toast('A few required questions still need an answer') fires — good. No dead-end.
IntakeCard.jsx: 'Not answered yet' text is only shown pre-completion; once complete the check icon path is used. Good. Uses `Array.isArray(a) ? a.join(', ')` for multi-choice — correct.

Layout.jsx alerts panel: severity styling is inline className ternaries — `a.severity === 'critical' ? terracotta : a.severity === 'info' ? sage : sand`. The 'info' type label color uses text-forest (green), critical uses text-terracotta. Visual distinction verified in-browser.
Encounter page has no auto-refetch of the briefing when intake state changes — see integration_issues above.
seed_data_creation: Generated intake for enc_fc5e6d2f320f (Sami's 2026-08-21) as instructed and completed all 8 answers as the patient. Also regenerated Sami's briefing on that encounter. The three pre-existing intake forms (enc_8eb16f42b750 Noura, enc_999ab1738214 Omar, enc_2cead3245352 Sami 2026-08-27) were NOT touched, per the reviewer's note — however the wizard for enc_2cead3245352 was completed during Step 2-5 of the first pass (patient dashboard's intake-prompt-card pointed to that encounter first). This may have converted enc_2cead3245352 from partial to complete state; verify if that matters for downstream tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State at end of run: enc_fc5e6d2f320f has a Complete intake (8 Qs, all answered — free text 'I have been feeling okay, occasional tiredness in the afternoon.', scale 5/10 for sleep, 'Very good' overall health, 'Never' missed meds, 'I forgot' as barrier, 'Never' impact/stress, 'Eating habits' focus) and a v2 briefing that cites intake. enc_2cead3245352 also got completed inadvertently (see seed_data_creation). The /auth page does not have auth-* testids — use generic input[type=email]/[type=password]/button[type=submit]. Info alerts render with className containing 'border-sage/50 bg-sage/10', critical alerts with 'border-terracotta/40 bg-terracotta/5' — this is the only way to assert severity styling today.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no product bugs. One minor UX gap flagged: existing pre-intake briefings do not auto-update after intake completes; manual Regenerate is required. Correct behavior when triggered.
